en: The postcard features an illustration of a woman in traditional German folk costume, holding a similarly dressed doll, standing in a lush park with manicured lawns and large trees. In the background, there is a grand building that appears to be a palace or manor. The front side includes the text 'Gruss aus Pyrmont.' The reverse includes classic postcard markings and a stamp denoting 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
